turns.query: Using SEC MIDAS individual security-by-exchange observations and FINRA consolidated daily short-volume files for April 2025, first determine their common trading dates. For cross-source ticker identity, match a MIDAS dot-form share-class ticker to the FINRA symbol obtained by replacing its period separator with a slash; otherwise require exact ticker-string equality. A ticker enters the comparison only if, on every common date, it has at least one MIDAS observation with both trade and odd-lot volume reported and one FINRA row. Across that full-coverage common population, aggregate MIDAS volumes before forming shares and rank tickers by absolute aggregate odd-lot volume, breaking ties alphabetically. Report the common-date and eligible-ticker counts, the ordered top-five ticker cohort, and for the leading ticker its aggregate MIDAS trade volume, odd-lot volume and odd-lot share. Within that five-ticker cohort, rank by aggregate FINRA short volume divided by aggregate FINRA total volume, separately report short-exempt volume, and break ties alphabetically. Report that leader, its MIDAS odd-lot-volume rank, MIDAS odd-lot volume and share, and its FINRA short, short-exempt and total volumes plus short-volume share. Explain how the two leadership measures relate and the limits of combining their interpretations.
